Welcome

A Free Online Seminary for Serious Bible and Ministry Training
Seminari ya Bure Mtandaoni kwa Mafunzo Makini ya Biblia na Huduma

Each course is a complete, self-study program you can work through entirely in your browser. Every lesson is offered in English, Spanish, and French, with built-in review and a certificate at the end. Begin with any of the seven foundation courses, in whatever order suits you; the rest of the catalog opens once they are complete, and your progress is saved as you go.

Anza na kozi yoyote kati ya kozi saba za msingi, kwa mpangilio wowote unaokufaa; kozi nyingine zote za katalogi zinafunguliwa zikishakamilika, na maendeleo yako yanahifadhiwa unapoendelea.

Every course you finish earns a Class Certificate. As your courses add up, you earn the seminary’s higher recognitions — at the certificate level, or, with the added written work, at the master’s level. Choose the path that fits your calling, and aim as high as you wish.

How to Proceed
Jinsi ya Kuendelea

Start with the foundation, and register. Open the first lesson of any of the seven foundation courses. Enter your name and select your track (Certificate, Associate, Th.M., or M.Div.) — saved automatically and carried across every course. The rest of the catalog unlocks once the seven foundation courses are complete.

Anza na msingi, na ujisajili. Fungua somo la kwanza la kozi yoyote kati ya kozi saba za msingi. Andika jina lako na uchague programu yako (Cheti, Shahada ya Mshiriki, Th.M., au M.Div.) — inahifadhiwa yenyewe na kutumika katika kila kozi. Kozi nyingine zote za katalogi zinafunguliwa kozi saba za msingi zikishakamilika.
Study each unit in order. Read the lesson in English, Spanish, or French — use the language toggle on each page to switch at any time.
Soma kila sehemu kwa mpangilio. Soma somo kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa au Kiswahili — tumia kitufe cha lugha kwenye kila ukurasa kubadilisha wakati wowote.

Complete the review. Each unit ends with a multiple-choice review. Associate, Th.M. and M.Div. students also answer ten fill-in-the-blank questions, and Th.M. and M.Div. students ten short answers as well. Pass every part your track includes, at 90%, to unlock the next unit.

Kamilisha marudio. Kila sehemu inamalizika kwa marudio ya maswali ya kuchagua jibu. Wanafunzi wa Shahada ya Mshiriki, Th.M. na M.Div. pia hujibu maswali kumi ya kujaza pengo, na wanafunzi wa Th.M. na M.Div. pia maswali kumi ya majibu mafupi. Faulu kila sehemu ambayo programu yako inajumuisha, kwa asilimia 90, ili kufungua sehemu inayofuata.

Learn it, and try again if you need to. Our examinations are designed to help you learn, not to trick you. Our goal is mastery of the material. If you do not reach the required score on your first attempt, review the lesson and try again — after a short wait, you may retake an examination as many times as you need. We care more about what you eventually learn than about how many attempts it takes.

Jifunze, na ujaribu tena ikiwa unahitaji. Mitihani yetu imeundwa kukusaidia kujifunza, si kukutega. Lengo letu ni ujuzi kamili wa somo. Usipofikia alama inayohitajika katika jaribio lako la kwanza, pitia somo kisha ujaribu tena — baada ya muda mfupi, unaweza kurudia mtihani mara nyingi kadiri unavyohitaji. Tunajali zaidi kile utakachojifunza hatimaye kuliko idadi ya majaribio itakayochukua.

Earn the certificate. When every unit is passed, the course certificate unlocks. On the M.Div. and Th.M. tracks, a course with a textbook or required readings is complete when its test is passed as well; Certificate and Associate students are not held by it. Enter your name and print or save it as a PDF.

Pata cheti. Kila sehemu ikishafaulu, cheti cha kozi kinafunguliwa. Katika programu za M.Div. na Th.M., kozi yenye kitabu cha kiada au masomo ya lazima inakamilika mtihani wake pia ukishafaulu; wanafunzi wa Cheti na wa Shahada ya Mshiriki hawazuiliwi nao. Andika jina lako kisha uchapishe cheti au ukihifadhi kama PDF.

Is Chapala Theological Seminary completely free?
Je, Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala ni bure kabisa?
Yes. Every course at Chapala Theological Seminary (CTS) is 100% free, with no tuition, fees, or hidden costs, for pastors and lay leaders anywhere in the world.
Ndiyo. Kila kozi katika Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala (CTS) ni bure kwa asilimia 100, bila karo, ada, wala gharama zilizofichwa, kwa wachungaji na viongozi walei popote duniani.
Where can I study seminary online for free?
Ninaweza kusomea seminari mtandaoni bure wapi?

Chapala Theological Seminary (CTS) is a free online seminary offering 65 complete self-study courses in English, Spanish, and French, in Bible, theology, preaching, pastoral ministry, counseling, and missions, with Certificate, Th.M., M.Div., and Associate of Divinity tracks — unlike sites that publish free theological articles or lectures but are not structured as an actual academic program.

Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala (CTS) ni seminari ya bure mtandaoni inayotoa kozi 65 kamili za kujisomea kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa na Kiswahili, katika Biblia, teolojia, kuhubiri, huduma ya kichungaji, ushauri na misheni, pamoja na programu za Cheti, Th.M., M.Div. na Shahada ya Mshiriki — tofauti na tovuti zinazochapisha makala au mihadhara ya kitheolojia bure lakini hazijapangwa kama programu halisi ya kitaaluma.
What free seminary courses does CTS offer?
CTS inatoa kozi gani za seminari bure?
CTS offers 65 self-study courses across six volumes, covering biblical studies, theology, church history, and practical ministry — available in English, Spanish, and French.
CTS inatoa kozi 65 za kujisomea katika juzuu sita, zinazohusu masomo ya Biblia, teolojia, historia ya kanisa na huduma ya vitendo — zinapatikana kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa na Kiswahili.
What credentials can I earn?
Ninaweza kupata tuzo gani?

Students can pursue a Certificate of Ministry (12 courses), an Associate of Divinity (25 courses), a Master of Theology, Th.M. (15 courses), or a Master of Divinity, M.Div. (30 courses). Every student studies the same teaching content and begins with the same seven foundation courses. The programs differ in the work required in each unit: the Certificate takes the multiple-choice review; the Associate adds fill-in-the-blank questions; the Th.M. and M.Div. add written short answers and, in courses that have them, a textbook or required-readings test. The M.Div. also requires a specific 20-course core.

Wanafunzi wanaweza kusomea Cheti (kozi 12), Shahada ya Mshiriki (kozi 25), Shahada ya Uzamili ya Teolojia, Th.M. (kozi 15), au Shahada ya Uzamili ya Huduma ya Kiungu, M.Div. (kozi 30). Kila mwanafunzi anasoma mafundisho yale yale na anaanza na kozi zile zile saba za msingi. Programu zinatofautiana katika kazi inayohitajika katika kila sehemu: Cheti kinafanya marudio ya maswali ya kuchagua jibu; Shahada ya Mshiriki inaongeza maswali ya kujaza pengo; Th.M. na M.Div. zinaongeza majibu mafupi ya maandishi na, katika kozi zilizo nao, mtihani wa kitabu cha kiada au wa masomo ya lazima. M.Div. pia inahitaji kiini maalum cha kozi 20.
Is CTS accredited?
Je, CTS imeidhinishwa rasmi (accredited)?

No. CTS is not accredited. Its Certificate, Associate, Th.M. and M.Div. recognize ministry study completed at CTS; they are not official academic degrees. CTS is currently pursuing formal recognition as an educational institution in Mexico. The seminary’s teaching faculty have themselves taught theology at an advanced level, and CTS was built to bring that same rigor to pastors and lay leaders who cannot access traditional, accredited institutions — particularly where cost, location, or language are barriers.

Hapana. CTS haijaidhinishwa rasmi. Cheti chake, Shahada ya Mshiriki, Th.M. na M.Div. zinatambua masomo ya huduma yaliyokamilishwa katika CTS; si shahada rasmi za kitaaluma. Kwa sasa CTS inashughulikia kutambuliwa rasmi kama taasisi ya elimu nchini Meksiko. Walimu wa seminari wenyewe wamefundisha teolojia katika ngazi ya juu, na CTS ilijengwa kuleta umakini huo huo kwa wachungaji na viongozi walei wasioweza kufikia taasisi za kawaida zilizoidhinishwa — hasa pale ambapo gharama, mahali, au lugha ni vikwazo.
Who is CTS for?
CTS ni kwa ajili ya nani?

CTS was built primarily for pastors and lay leaders who lack access to traditional seminary education — including many in Cuba and Mexico, among other places — but the courses are open to anyone, anywhere, who wants free, serious theological training in English, Spanish, or French.

CTS ilijengwa hasa kwa ajili ya wachungaji na viongozi walei wasio na nafasi ya elimu ya kawaida ya seminari — wakiwemo wengi nchini Cuba na Meksiko, miongoni mwa maeneo mengine — lakini kozi ziko wazi kwa mtu yeyote, mahali popote, anayetaka mafunzo makini ya kitheolojia bure kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa au Kiswahili.
What theological perspective does CTS teach from?
CTS inafundisha kutoka mtazamo gani wa kitheolojia?

CTS teaches from a non-denominational evangelical perspective while presenting differing views (such as Calvinist vs. Arminian, differing understandings of perseverance and security, and the major millennial positions) fairly and even-handedly rather than requiring one denominational system.

CTS inafundisha kutoka mtazamo wa kiinjili usio wa kimadhehebu, huku ikiwasilisha mitazamo tofauti (kama Calvin dhidi ya Arminius, maoni tofauti kuhusu kudumu katika imani na uhakika wa wokovu, na misimamo mikuu kuhusu milenia) kwa haki na bila upendeleo, badala ya kulazimisha mfumo mmoja wa kimadhehebu.
Is CTS Baptist?
Je, CTS ni ya Kibaptisti?
No. CTS is non-denominational and is not affiliated with or presented as a Baptist institution.
Hapana. CTS si ya kimadhehebu na haihusiani na wala haijitambulishi kama taasisi ya Kibaptisti.

About Chapala Theological Seminary
Kuhusu Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala

Chapala Theological Seminary is a free online seminary offering complete, Christ-centered self-study courses in Bible, theology, preaching, pastoral ministry, counseling, missions, and related fields — in English, Spanish, and French, at no cost, and at your own pace.

Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala ni seminari ya bure mtandaoni inayotoa kozi kamili za kujisomea zinazomweka Kristo katikati, katika Biblia, teolojia, kuhubiri, huduma ya kichungaji, ushauri, misheni, na nyanja zinazohusiana — kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa na Kiswahili, bila gharama, na kwa kasi yako mwenyewe.

Each course is a complete, self-study program students work through entirely in their browser. Every lesson is offered side-by-side in English and Spanish, with built-in review and a certificate at the end. The seminary currently offers 65 courses, organized into a Certificate of Ministry, an Associate of Divinity, a Master of Theology, and a Master of Divinity.

Kila kozi ni programu kamili ya kujisomea ambayo wanafunzi wanaifanya yote kwenye kivinjari chao. Kila somo linapatikana kwa lugha zaidi ya moja, likiwa na marudio ndani yake na cheti mwishoni. Kwa sasa seminari inatoa kozi 65, zilizopangwa katika Cheti, Shahada ya Mshiriki, Shahada ya Uzamili ya Teolojia, na Shahada ya Uzamili ya Huduma ya Kiungu.
Our Mission
Utume Wetu

Chapala Theological Seminary exists to make sound, Christ-centered biblical and theological education freely available to anyone with the hunger to study — regardless of their ability to pay or their access to a traditional seminary. Whether a student is preparing for pastoral ministry, deepening a lifelong walk with God, or simply hungry to study His Word more carefully, there is a place for them here.

Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala ipo ili kufanya elimu sahihi ya Kibiblia na ya kitheolojia inayomweka Kristo katikati ipatikane bure kwa mtu yeyote mwenye kiu ya kusoma — bila kujali uwezo wake wa kulipa au nafasi yake ya kufikia seminari ya kawaida. Iwe mwanafunzi anajiandaa kwa huduma ya kichungaji, anaimarisha mwenendo wake wa maisha yote pamoja na Mungu, au ana kiu tu ya kusoma Neno lake kwa uangalifu zaidi, kuna nafasi kwa ajili yake hapa.

Welcome, and thank you for joining us. Chapala Theological Seminary is a free online seminary offering complete, Christ-centered self-study courses in Bible, theology, preaching, pastoral ministry, counseling, missions, and related fields — in English, Spanish, and French, at no cost, and at your own pace. Whether you are preparing for ministry, deepening a lifelong walk with God, or simply hungry to study His Word more carefully, there is a place for you here.

Karibu, na asante kwa kujiunga nasi. Seminari ya Kitheolojia ya Chapala ni seminari ya bure mtandaoni inayotoa kozi kamili za kujisomea zinazomweka Kristo katikati, katika Biblia, teolojia, kuhubiri, huduma ya kichungaji, ushauri, misheni, na nyanja zinazohusiana — kwa Kiingereza, Kihispania, Kifaransa na Kiswahili, bila gharama, na kwa kasi yako mwenyewe. Iwe unajiandaa kwa huduma, unaimarisha mwenendo wako wa maisha yote pamoja na Mungu, au una kiu tu ya kusoma Neno lake kwa uangalifu zaidi, kuna nafasi kwa ajili yako hapa.
